title: SettingsChange
description: SETTINGS-AUDIT-01: one record of an owner or admin changing a safety-relevant setting (a key that widens or narrows what a child or teen can reach, or a role default or override under the content filter, Home RULES.md area 'Content filter and feature access'). Shown to owners and admins. Rule 6a: the record carries the actor's role, never a person id or name, and for a per-person key it says only that the scope was a person. The hub writes one per accepted write; a refused write leaves none.

key.description: The settings key, as declared in settings/keys.json.

scope.description: Which layer was written. A person-scoped change names no person (rule 6a).

actor_role.description: Only an owner or admin can write a listed key; a teen or child never produces a record.

value.description: The new value as written, any JSON.

previous.description: The value before the write, when the hub had one; absent when the key had no stored value.

direction.description: Whether the change gives a child or teen more reach (widens), less (narrows), or is not ordered (changes). Decided by the hub per key where an order is known.
